svg.title: An elementary stencil is a finite signed shifted-edge sum, with axis, offsets and ordered deriva- tive list Da. Its two-point form consequently has four terms, with signs +, −, −, +. Its Fourier polynomial factors into sign, translation character and difference multipliers. Multiplication gives the exact identity X Y atbsχp(z + ut ± vs) = σa,b,±χp(z + ua,± + ub,±) qν(p).
